Stop.command:
osascript -e 'on run argv' -e 'set p to paragraphs of (item 1 of argv)' -e 'if (count of p) is 3 then display notification (item 1 of p) with title "Antigravity" subtitle (item 2 of p) sound name (item 3 of p)' -e 'end run' -- "$(/usr/bin/python3 -c 'import json,os,sys; d=json.load(sys.stdin); ws=(d.get("workspacePaths") or [os.getcwd()])[0]; r=d.get("terminationReason",""); r!="USER_CANCELED" and print(("Turn ended with an error
" if r=="ERROR" else "Turn complete
")+os.path.basename(ws.rstrip("/"))+"
"+("Basso" if r=="ERROR" else "Ping"))')"; printf '{}
'

hooks.command: osascript -e 'on run argv' -e 'display notification (item 1 of argv) with title "Antigravity" subtitle (item 2 of argv) sound name "Ping"' -e 'end run' -- 'Antigravity has a question' "$(/usr/bin/python3 -c 'import json,os,sys; d=json.load(sys.stdin); ws=(d.get("workspacePaths") or [os.getcwd()])[0]; print(os.path.basename(ws.rstrip("/")))')" && printf '{"decision":"allow"}\n'

osascript -e 'on run argv' -e 'set p to paragraphs of (item 1 of argv)' -e 'if (item 1 of p) is "ask" then display notification "Antigravity needs permission" with title "Antigravity" subtitle (item 2 of p) sound name "Ping"' -e 'return "{\"decision\":\"" & (item 1 of p) & "\"}"' -e 'end run' -- "$(/usr/bin/python3 -c 'import json,os,sys; d=json.load(sys.stdin); ws=(d.get("workspacePaths") or [os.getcwd()])[0]; tc=d.get("toolCall") or {}; n=tc.get("name",""); a=tc.get("args") or {}; roots=[os.path.realpath(p) for p in [*(d.get("workspacePaths") or [os.getcwd()]), d.get("artifactDirectoryPath") or "", os.path.expanduser("~/.gemini/antigravity/brain"), "/tmp", "/private/tmp"] if p]; path=a.get("Path") or ""; rp=os.path.realpath(os.path.expanduser(path)) if path else ""; in_roots=bool(rp) and any(rp==r or rp.startswith(r+"/") for r in roots); parts=set(rp.split("/")) if rp else set(); prot=n in ("write_file","edit_file") and bool(parts & {".vscode",".git",".gemini"} or os.path.basename(rp)=="hooks.json"); ask=bool(a.get("BypassSandbox")) if n=="run_command" else (bool(rp) and (not in_roots or prot)); print(("ask" if ask else "allow")+"\n"+os.path.basename(ws.rstrip("/")))')"
